questions.q: What does an accelerometer measure in steady hover?
questions.explain: An accelerometer measures the support reaction, the specific force, not the acceleration relative to the ground.

questions.q: Integrated, a gyro bias of 0.05 °/s gives an angle error per minute of:
What does a 6-position accelerometer calibration calibrate?
questions.explain: Six known orientations give a system for the offsets and scales.

questions.q: Hard iron in compass calibration is:
options: A constant offset of the field
questions.explain: Hard iron shifts the measurement sphere; soft iron turns it into an ellipsoid.

questions.q: What does VIBE.Clip > 0 mean in ArduPilot?
options: The barometer drifts as it heats up
questions.explain: Clipping means exceeding the sensor's measurement range.

questions.q: Which biases does EKF3 estimate in flight?
questions.explain: Sensor biases are part of the EKF3 state vector.

questions.q: Why does a compass give the wrong heading without knowing roll and pitch?
options: The vertical field component leaks into the axes
questions.explain: The large vertical component (inclination up to 70°) projects onto the horizontal axes when tilted.

questions.q: Why does the gyro bias change after power-on?
options: Temperature drift as the board warms up
questions.explain: Temperature drift of 0.005–0.05 °/s per °C: the board warming up shifts the bias.
